title: Towneers FAQ: 46 questions about the free social life sim in your browser
html:
Towneers is a free-to-play social multiplayer online game: a life simulator and browser MMO set in one shared pixel city. You open the site, make a character and appear on the central square next to real people, with no download and no install. It is a cozy sim with teeth: jobs, cafés you can own, homes you can build, farms, fishing piers, a funfair and a player economy where the prices come from real deals between people.

This FAQ collects the 46 questions newcomers ask most, with the real numbers from the game's current settings. Towneers is in alpha, so figures can change, but everything below is checked against the live game data. Skim the headings, jump to what you care about, and when you are ready, the pixel city is one click away.

▶ Play Towneers free in your browser

Getting started

What is Towneers?

Towneers is a free multiplayer life simulation in a pixel-art isometric city that runs in your browser on phones, tablets and computers. You create a character, arrive on the central square and live your own story: get a job, open a café, rent an apartment, build a house on your own plot, grow crops, craft furniture and spend an evening at the funfair. There is one shared city for everyone, with 297 buildings and 91 plots of land. There is no single goal and no level you have to beat.

Is Towneers really free to play?

Yes. You can play with no time limits and never pay. Jobs, businesses, homes, plots, farms and crafts are all earned with in-game gold. Optional purchases (gems and Premium) start from $1, and every price is listed openly in USD on the shop page.

How do I start playing?

Open the play page and the character editor appears right away. Choose a look and a name, and you land on the central square with 🪙600 in your pocket. The first visit needs no sign-up. A nine-step tutorial teaches the one button that does almost everything, and finishing it pays out gold, a gift of 10 gems and your own apartment.

What can I actually do in the game?

There are 19 jobs and professions, 28 kinds of business you can open, homes you can rent, buy or build, 9 crops to farm, 198 crafting recipes and 443 items. You can also ride scooters and cars, fish, visit a funfair with 8 rides and compete in 20 leaderboards. Nobody is locked into one path: a courier in the morning can be a cook in the evening. For a gentle first plan, read how to earn your first 1,000 gold.

Devices & account

Do I need to download or install anything?

No. Towneers is a website, so there is nothing to download. On a phone you can add it to the home screen (it works as a PWA) and it opens like an app. It does need an internet connection, because it is an online multiplayer game and does not work offline.

Which devices and browsers work?

Any modern browser on Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS and Linux. It also works on a Chromebook: the game was checked at 1366×768, the usual Chromebook screen size, and the whole interface fits. On a computer you walk with WASD or by clicking, press E to use things, and open the bag, map, skills and crafting with I, M, K and C. On a phone there is a joystick and one big action button.

How do I save my progress and keep my character?

The character is saved on the server right away. To play on any device and never lose it, link an email or a Google account. After that the same character opens on your phone, tablet or laptop.

Which languages are supported?

Five: English (the default), Español, Deutsch, Українська and Русский. You can change the language in the settings at any time.

Money & jobs

How do I earn my first gold?

Finish the tutorial, take the 🎁 daily reward, work as a courier and go fishing. The daily reward runs over a 7-day calendar and pays a big gift with 🪙180 on day 7. Each full week in a row adds +10% to the money, up to +50%. Five weekly goals from Monday each pay gold and experience, and finishing all five opens a chest with 🪙300 and 10 gems. The full beginner plan is in the first 1,000 gold guide.

What jobs are there?

Nineteen ways to earn. Four are city jobs: courier, street cleaner, fisher (all from level 1) and taxi driver (from level 3, in your own car). Nine are shift roles in businesses, such as cashier, cook or barista, stocker, cleaner, stylist, DJ and farm hand. Six are crafts: cooking, fishing, carpentry, tailoring, mechanics and farming, which rank up with practice and unlock better quality.

Is the courier job a good start?

It is the best first job: it starts at level 1 and needs no tools. You pick up a parcel at the post office and carry it to the address along a route drawn with yellow arrows. Deliver within the express time and you get a bonus, tips and a streak. The first 20 deliveries of a game day go without fatigue, and a kick scooter (🪙220) helps you hit the express time more often.

Do I have to be online to work a shift?

Yes. A shift is work done by your character inside the place. Owners can also hire residents, who work 8-hour shifts, so a long day needs two shifts.

Player economy & Trading House

How do prices work in Towneers?

The city covers the basics and the best goods are made by players. The city always buys from you a little cheaper than players usually pay each other. The city's price is about 35% of retail, and each sale to the same shop lowers the next price. Item prices come from recorded deals, so the card for an item shows what players usually pay.

What is the Trading House?

It is the player market. You put items up as lots or post buy orders, and the city takes a 5% fee on a sale. A "🔥 Wanted" tab shows what people are looking for right now, and every item card shows a two-week price chart. Selling there usually earns more than selling to the city. More in the market guide.

Does quality matter when I sell?

Very much. Crafted goods and crops come in ★, ★★ and ★★★, and higher quality sells for more, both to players and to cafés that order ★★ or ★★★ produce. Rare fish, three-star crops and crafted furniture are worth selling to people rather than the city. That is why a craft skill pays off.

Can I trade directly with another player?

Yes. You can swap items and gold with another player face to face. You can also fill buy orders in someone's café, or sell quality items from the shelves of your own shop.

Business & cafés

How do I open a café?

Walk to a vacant premises (the map marks them "Vacant"), choose the Café template, rent or buy the place and it opens with equipment and a starter menu. Vacant premises rent for 🪙242–352 per game day or sell for 🪙24,800–36,000, and the café equipment costs about 🪙2,810. You can rent up to 2 premises at a time. The step-by-step version is how to open a café.

What other businesses can I open?

There are 28 kinds, from a coffee shop, pizzeria, burger bar and bakery to a bar, clothes shop, pharmacy, bookshop, cinema and hotel. Names are unique in the city, so pick your own. You can also build a shop pavilion on your own plot.

Can other players work in my place?

Yes. Your vacancies are open to residents and real players, and you choose who to hire. You can also stand behind the counter yourself, which helps while you have no staff.

Does the city help a new business?

For the first 48 game hours after opening there are no utility bills, and the city pays half of the residents' wages. At the recommended price about 9 guests in 10 buy, while at double the price only about a third do. When you want out, the city pays 70% of the business's value, or you can sell it to another player.

Teams & factories

How do I found a team?

Reach level 3 and pay 🪙1,000, then choose a name, a 2–4 character tag and a colour. A team is a permanent company of up to 30 players with a tag over your heads, a chat tab, a treasury and a place in the city ranking. A party, by contrast, lasts only one session.

How much does a factory cost?

A team can rent a hall in the Industrial Zone. The Workshop hall (14×10 tiles) rents for 🪙150 per game day or costs 🪙18,000 to own. The bigger Factory hall (20×12 tiles) is 🪙350 per day or 🪙45,000, paid in gold only. Rent comes out of the factory cash box, so keep a reserve of at least three days.

What does a factory make?

Furniture from logs, bread and sandwiches from flour, eggs, milk, cheese and tomatoes, and sneakers from leather, plastic and fabric. You install machines and conveyor belts together, set recipes and sell the output to city shops, to players in the Trading House or to team members' cafés. The whole chain is explained in the teams and factories guide.

Does a factory run while I am offline?

Yes, for a while. It keeps working for 4 game hours after the last member leaves, and up to 12 game hours with a hired resident shift master, whose wage is 🪙14 per game hour from the cash box.

Homes, plots & house builder

How do I get a home?

There are three ways: rent an apartment or house, buy one, or buy a plot and build your own. Apartments rent for 🪙44–78 per game day and sell for 🪙4,700–8,200. Houses rent for 🪙133–272 per day and sell for 🪙28,200–62,000. Rent is not charged below level 5 or during your first 3 days. See how to get a house.

How much does a plot of land cost?

City plots cost 🪙12,100–34,200, Cottage Hill plots 🪙19,100–29,500 and North Farms plots 🪙2,700–5,400. Free plots carry a red SALE sign. You can own up to 4 plots, and Cottage Hill is quiet and houses only, which makes it a good first plot.

Can I design my own house?

Yes. The house builder lets you choose a width and depth of 3 to 6 tiles and 1 to 3 floors. You pick the roof, the details and the colours, and a preview shows the price and the build time before you commit. "Rebuild" changes the look later for a fraction of the price. The yard can get beds, trees, a pool, a grill, a garage for up to 3 cars and a plaque with your name. The full walk-through is the plot and house guide.

Can I decorate and invite friends?

Yes. You furnish with 40+ kinds of catalogue furniture or pieces crafted by players, and friends can visit by default (you can change access in the home settings). Rented homes take up to 25 of your own furniture items and owned homes up to 60. Heavy pieces such as a hot tub or pool table need a home you own.

Farming & fishing

How do I start a farm?

Take bus line 4 from the square (🪙2) to North Farms and buy a plot with a FARM SALE sign. Then build the "Farm" project, which puts up a barn with a water pump and a fence, till a bed with a hoe, plant, water and harvest. Crops keep growing while you are offline, but dry or overripe beds can wilt, rot or get weeds. One game day lasts 24 real minutes.

What can I grow and where does it sell?

There are 9 crops and 5 seed tiers, with quality from ★ to ★★★. Crops sell to city kitchens, to the co-op in bulk with a daily quota per crop, to café delivery orders, or to players. Because the quota is per crop, growing several kinds pays better than filling the city with potatoes. Everything is in the farming guide.

How does fishing work?

Anyone can fish; the Fisher job is optional. Buy a rod for 🪙60 at the fishing shop, walk to the edge of a pier, shore or lake and press the action button. When the float dives with a splash and a "!", tap it. Three precise hooks in a row start a 60-second Hot bite where rare fish bite twice as often. Fishing skill runs from 0 to 300.

Where can I fish and sell the catch?

There are three main spots: the sea pier and shore on the south waterfront, the lake pier in Central Park, and the waterfall pool, which is the only place where Rainbow trout bite. Cafés and restaurant kitchens buy fish you caught, and rare fish do better with players. Everything about rods, bait and every fish is in the fishing guide.

Transport & fun

How do I get around the city?

On foot, by scooter or bike, by car, by taxi or by bus. A kick scooter costs 🪙220 and needs no licence, and a city bike is 🪙680. Buses cost 🪙2 and four lines cross the city (Ring, Seaside, Boulevard and Farms), and taxis start from 🪙5. Press V to get on and off a scooter or bike.

What cars can I buy?

Seven cars are sold for gold, from 🪙4,800 to 🪙42,000, and six exclusive models are for gems, including a helicopter. You need a driving licence first, which costs 🪙150 at the police station. You can own up to 3 regular cars, and a garage on your plot holds 3.

What is there to do at the funfair?

The funfair is an island in the bay with 8 rides (Ferris wheel, carousel, roller coaster, free-fall tower, swinging ship, chain swing, bumper cars and haunted house) and 5 games. Tickets cost 🪙3–15. Everyone on board a ride starts it together, so it is an easy place to meet people. Your results count toward the funfair board.

Hall of Fame & events

What is the Hall of Fame?

It is a board and a champions' podium on the central square, by the City Hall. It tracks 20 leaderboards, covering wealth, level, work, fishing, crafts, farming, business, football, reputation and the funfair. There are also 33 trophies in bronze, silver and gold, and titles you can show above your head.

How do weekly champions work?

The week runs from Monday to Monday. When it ends, the top three of each weekly board get 🪙500, 🪙250 and 🪙100, and the winner becomes the champion with a crown, a title and a place on the podium for the next week.

Can a new player reach the Hall of Fame?

Yes. Weekly boards start from zero every Monday, and there is a separate board for rookies of the week. Only what you actually do in the game counts, and test or admin accounts are not ranked.

Premium, gems & prices

What are gems and Premium?

Gems are the premium currency, and Premium is a 30-day subscription for $4.99. Gems buy costumes (there are 5), exclusive vehicles and shortcuts. Premium also doubles the weekly chest's gems from 10 to 20. Optional purchases start from $1.

Do I need to pay to progress?

No. Everything in the city is earned with gold, and gems are optional. For example, the farm cycle works without paying, and every route in a factory works with gold and time alone. A few extras exist for gems: a 24-hour Sonar for fishing (60 gems) and a factory installation crew at 2 gems per point.

Where do I see the prices?

Every price is listed in USD on the shop page, with what is included and the payment methods. Refund and privacy rules are linked from the site footer.

Community & safety

Can I play with friends?

Yes. Everyone shares one city, so you can send an invite link, add friends, chat, visit homes and work together. A friend who has not started yet can be invited by link and finds the invitation waiting.

Are the other characters real people?

Characters with a name above their head are real players. The city also has more than 750 computer-controlled residents who walk, shop, eat in cafés and take jobs in player businesses.

How do I block or report someone?

Tap any chat message and you can react, reply, add a friend, block or report. Support is also available through "Support and feedback" in the game menu, or at support@towneers.world. The terms of use list the rules that apply to you, including age.

Alpha status

What does "alpha" mean?

The game is playable every day and updated often, but it is still growing. Balance and numbers change, bugs happen and the world may be reset. Changes are announced in the blog.

Where can I find more answers?

The short official list is the Towneers FAQ, and the game guide covers each topic with real numbers. If your question is missing, write to support@towneers.world.

Towneers is a cozy, social and slightly ambitious way to spend an evening: free, in the browser, with real people and an economy that actually reacts to what you do. Pick a corner of the city, whether that is a pier, a farm or a café with a queue, and start from there.

▶ Play Towneers free in your browser
